title_en: An Empty Cart Returns: The Safe Mark

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: Let the cart stop if you need room. Its wheels are not a clock.

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: The dead follow the handle. Clear the next corner before you draw them there.

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: I remember this route. I should have used it.
